resources.string: Certificate changed
%1$s presents a different self-signed certificate than the one you trusted. If you didn\'t replace it, someone may be pretending to be your server.
Trust this certificate?
%1$s presents a certificate it signed itself. Trust it only if you set up this server.
Choose a channel
Clear the queue?
Every song but the one playing is removed from the queue.
Remove currently playing song
This will stop the player and close the fullscreen player
Forget certificate?
You\'ll be asked again before %1$s\'s certificate is trusted.
Reset the order?
The songs go back to the album\'s own order.
Save the changes?
You changed this playlist but haven\'t saved it yet.
You made changes but haven\'t saved them yet.
Delete playlist?
%1$s will be deleted. Its songs stay in your library.
Look up songs again?
The file has %1$s from %2$s. Looking them up brings their current titles and artists. Skip to import them as the file has them.
Takes up to about %1$s if every song has to be searched for again.
Search for the songs?
The file has %1$s from another service. Each one is searched for on %2$s and goes in as the song matching its title, artists and length. Songs without a match are left out.
Takes up to about %1$s.
Export playlist
Include songs from
Restart the app?
Playback stops and the app opens again, settings that need a restart apply then.
Restart the player?
Playback stops for a moment, then goes on where it was with the new settings.
The sleep timer is on, it stops with the player.
Cached song
It will be moved to your downloads and kept on this device until you delete it.
The cached copy is worse than the quality set now, so the song will be downloaded again.
Cached: %1$s\nDownloads in: %2$s
Delete backup?
%1$s will be deleted online. It can\'t be recovered.
Delete download?
%1$s will be removed from this device. It can still be streamed.
Stop download?
%1$s won\'t be downloaded.
Restore a backup?
Every profile, setting and the library are replaced with the backup\'s, then the app restarts. Passwords and sign ins of profiles in the backup that are on this device are kept.
Undislike all?
Every song this profile disliked shows up in its lists again.
Only the songs matching your filters show up in your lists again. The rest stay hidden.
Unlike all?
Every song this profile liked is no longer liked.
Only the songs matching your filters are no longer liked. The rest stay liked.
Liked songs from %1$s are also unliked on your account there while you\'re signed in and liked songs sync is on.
Liked songs from %1$s are also removed from its favorites while liked songs sync is on.
Delete all downloads?
Every song this profile downloaded is removed from this device. They can still be streamed.
The downloaded songs shown are removed from this device, the others stay. They can still be streamed.
Clear the image cache?
Every image kept on this device is removed, they load again when shown.
Also clear images kept in memory
Clear the song cache?
Every streamed song kept on this device is removed, for every profile. Downloads stay.
Delete every profile\'s downloads?
Every downloaded song is removed from this device, for every profile. They can still be streamed.
Smaller than what\'s stored
%1$s is stored, more than %2$s. Once the app restarts, what doesn\'t fit is removed, what was used least recently first.
Turn it off?
%1$s is stored. Once the app restarts, all of it is removed and nothing new is kept.
Downloads take %1$s. None are deleted, but no new song can be downloaded.
Downloads take %1$s, more than %2$s. None are deleted, but new downloads are refused until there is room.
Search lyrics
Find the recording
No recordings found
Find the artist
No artists found
Sign out of %1$s?
The saved username, password and API key are removed. You can sign in again any time.
Your %1$s library stops showing here, the songs you liked stay liked. You can sign in again any time.
Downloads from the old app
Found %1$s of your library downloaded in the old app. Download again?
Your %1$s profile stops showing what you play. You can sign in again any time.
Cloud backup stops on this device. You can sign in again any time.

Identifying the song…
No match found. Try again closer to the music
Couldn\'t find it on %1$s
Couldn\'t look up the song, check the connection
Hold the button while the song plays for at least %1$s
Listening…
Reset settings?
Every setting of this profile goes back to its default and it is signed out of every account and server. Storage sizes stay.
Clear search history?
Every search this profile made is forgotten.
Clear listening history?
Every song this profile played is taken out of its history, and its statistics start over.
Clean up the database?
For every profile: songs never played or changed and in no playlist, albums and artists never changed, and playlists without songs are removed. Songs on the device stay.
